usedFor: A new Freshdesk ticket can open a HubSpot deal when support hears a sales opportunity.

bestTemplate.name: “New Ticket” in Freshdesk, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A ticket carries a real customer and request, a better deal start than a bare contact.

watchOut: Every “New Ticket” would open a deal, so most teams filter it; “Update Deal” needs a deal ID.
